title: aboveR: LiDAR Terrain Analysis and Change Detection from Above
description: R package for terrain change detection, cut/fill volume estimation, terrain profiling, flood inundation analysis, slope/aspect/hillshade computation, contour extraction, reclamation monitoring, erosion analysis, and engineering export from LiDAR point clouds and DEMs. Includes access utilities for KyFromAbove cloud-native elevation data on AWS.
